cells.description: Completed token-SFT metric suite, first COMPLETE two-digit number normalized among 00–99; not first tokenizer token or full ten-number sequence likelihood. Variant: causal raw. FP32 metric evaluation paired to the original auto/BF16 SL outcome, not FP32 reevaluation.

pca.axis_sign_rule: Largest absolute answer loading is positive; first index breaks ties.

metric1_audit.training: 00--99 token SFT, 10,000 accepted examples per teacher, three epochs, LoRA r=8 alpha=32
metric1_audit.event: First complete two-digit number at native assistant generation boundary; prompts still request ten numbers; candidate-normalized over 00--99
metric1_audit.neutral: Same model and prompt with the teacher system instruction omitted
metric1_audit.teacher_centering: Arithmetic mean over the 30 ordered teacher traits, excluding neutral
metric1_audit.current_aggregation: sum_x w(x) cosine(L_z(x,:), L_zprime(x,:)) / sum_x w(x); normalize within each prompt before averaging
metric1_audit.legacy_aggregation: Cosine after flattening sqrt(w(x))*L_z(x,c) over all prompt/carrier coordinates
metric1_audit.zero_norm_policy: Abort on any nonpositive or nonfinite positive-weight signature norm; no prompts dropped or norms clamped
metric1_audit.correlation: Double-center the complete 30-by-30 metric and SL matrices separately, then correlate all 900 or mask to 870 off-diagonal entries
metric1_audit.sl_orientation: Rows are answer traits; columns are teacher adapters; preserve directional SL without symmetrizing
metric1_audit.precision: CPU float64 aggregation of existing strict-FP32 model score caches; no inference

provenance.event: first complete two-digit number, conditioned over 00--99
provenance.prompt_weighting: Equal weight 1 per original prompt occurrence; first 1,024 unfiltered seed-42 generation requests, shared by all 30 teachers and neutral.
